changelog: Nested Folder Visibility & Recursive Bezier Branching: Subdirectories like src/ now appear directly in the sidebar tree with DIR badges and chevron indicators, unfolding children along nested curved bezier branches
Project Root Tree Representation: Repository and workspace root folder names (e.g. rp-clothing) are prominently displayed as root directory nodes with PROJECT badges in the branching tree
Codex-Style Multi-Chat Projects: Support multiple independent conversations per project; selecting a workspace now presents a smart picker to start a new chat or continue existing threads
One-Tap Workspace New Chat: Added a '+' action button directly on workspace group headers in the sidebar drawer to spin up new scoped conversations instantly
Smart Build Noise Filter: Automatically ignores noisy directories (.git, node_modules, build, .gradle, dist) to keep the sidebar responsive and source-focused
